type Opt<T> = { +readonly [K in keyof T]+?: T[K] };
type Req<T> = { [K in keyof T]-?: T[K] };
type Maybe<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] | null };
interface Cfg {
  host: string;
  port?: number;
}
const o: Opt<Cfg> = {};
const r: Req<Cfg> = { host: "h", port: 1 };
const m: Maybe<Cfg> = { host: null };
;
let i = 0;
for (; i < 2; i++);
console.log(o, r, m, i, <string>"cast", (<number>(1 as unknown)) + 1);
const Kls = class Named {
  static make() {
    return new Named();
  }
  hello() {
    return "hi";
  }
};
console.log(Kls.make().hello());
type Tpl = `${number}px`;
const w: Tpl = "10px";
type Fn = new (n: number) => { n: number };
const Ctor: Fn = class {
  constructor(public n: number) {}
};
console.log(w, new Ctor(3).n);
interface Callable {
  (x: number): string;
  label: string;
}
const fn = Object.assign((x: number) => `#${x}`, { label: "L" });
const c: Callable = fn;
console.log(c(1), c.label);
